reference: Closed-form effectiveness-NTU relations, the exact Mason series for crossflow with both fluids unmixed (cross-checked against a finite-difference solution of the crossflow PDE), LMTD and the Bowman/TEMA F factor - all implemented independently in python.

cases.note: Closed-form effectiveness-NTU relations (Kays & London Table 2-1 / Shah & Sekulic Table 3.3) evaluated in python; the tool is probed at exactly the same (arrangement, NTU, Cr).

Exact Mason(1954) series solution for crossflow with both fluids unmixed vs the standard engineering approximation. A finite-difference solution of the crossflow PDE is carried as an independent crosscheck.
The three mixed-crossflow closed forms. The tool offers only one ("Crossflow, Cmax mixed"); recorded so the label can be checked against the formula actually implemented.
The counterflow and 2-4 shell relations have removable singularities at Cr=1; a correct implementation must be continuous there.
F defined by Q = U A F LMTD_counterflow, derived from the eps-NTU relation; for the shell-and-tube arrangements the Bowman/TEMA closed form is computed as a second, independent reference.
LMTD closed form including the equal-approach limit.
